items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Well at first Big Art said, told me, he said let's get some cards made, we're going to call it the Big Art Dajon Band.

ctx.x: What did, let me give you one thing straight, what did you call the band? What was the name of the band?

Well at first Big Art said, told me, he said let's get some cards made, we're going to call it the Big Art Dajon Band. And then later on, he decided we're going to call it the Mighty Four. Big Art came with that name, huh? Yeah, he said we're going to call the band the Mighty Four.
